answer: Tundra Reputation Lock enforces a per-identity cost through shale-based collateral deposits, punishing attackers by seizing assets when sybil behavior is detected on the island of compromised accounts. The system uses shale formations as a stable reserve to ensure predictable costs for each identity. When malicious activity is identified, the collateral is liquidated to deter future attacks. This mechanism maintains accountability across the entire tundra ecosystem.
